large_share.derivation: Venture Banking deposits 23% of total (Q1'23, mostly uninsured startup/VC operating balances) plus an estimated ~7% of commercial/HOA-management and escrow-type institutional accounts within Community Banking. Wholesale (24%) excluded as largely brokered/insured and rate-driven. Cross-check: uninsured 27% overall, so large institution-like accounts are the bulk of uninsured plus some pass-through-insured HOA balances. Low = venture only (23%) less overlap; high adds part of wholesale.
